question: Haven — DEF, 2v4 down, no spike, ~1:00 left. You (Harbor) just killed one ATK at C Garage doors. Three attackers are still committing C. What now?

options.label: Fall back off the doors and reset to a fresh C angle with Cascade/Cove ready to stall
options.explication_courte: You just showed your position getting the pick — three more are pushing. Re-angle onto a spot they don't expect and use your wall/smoke to stall the take so your teammate can rotate. Don't re-hold the spot they now pre-aim.

sources_option.citation: After a kill, move to an off-angle or a different position — enemies expect you where you got the pick

options.label: Hold the exact doorway angle and try to pick a second attacker as they push
options.explication_courte: Greeding the same angle against three pushers who saw the muzzle flash is how a 1-for-1 becomes a 1-for-you. The next peeker is pre-aimed on your head.

sources_option.citation: Re-holding a burned angle against multiple pushers invites a pre-aimed trade; unpredictability keeps you alive

options.label: Use High Tide/Cascade to wall off C and buy time before deciding
options.explication_courte: Walling to stall is a legitimate 2v4 play and delays the plant. But dropping util from the burned doorway without re-angling first can leave you exposed the instant the wall drops — pair it with a reposition.

sources_option.citation: Utility to delay a numbers-down site take is sound, but must be combined with repositioning and info to convert the stall

options.label: Rotate fully to A now and give up C to the three attackers
options.explication_courte: You just took a fight for C — bailing hands them the site free and puts you in a worse 2v4 on A with no info. Convert the pick you earned into a stall, don't throw it away.

sources_option.citation: Rotating off a site you're actively contesting gives it up for free and can be punished by an alternate-angle push

explication_longue: Getting a pick on defense is a gift and a liability at the same time. The kill at C Garage doors bought you a temporary 2v3 on this site — but the muzzle flash also told three living attackers exactly where you are, and they are still pushing with the numbers. The Radiant instinct is to convert, not to greed: step off the burned doorway, re-angle onto a spot the pushers aren't pre-aiming, and use Harbor's kit (Cascade to stall the entry, Cove to block a defuse-line or your reposition, High Tide to wall the choke) to slow the take long enough for your surviving teammate to rotate in. Re-holding the same doorway is the classic tilt-trade — the next peeker is already on your head. Walling is good but only if you move first; drop the water from the exact spot they saw you and you die when it falls. Full-rotating to A throws away the fight you just won and lands you in an even worse 2v4 with zero information. Down a man, your job is to make every meter of the site cost them time and utility, from angles they can't predict.

sources.citation: Repositioning after duels lets you hold different angles while staying elusive even against a communicating enemy team
